name: c3-k
instruction: Follow the career-rules Skill and reread it whenever its rules are not in view. Decide stories only with its Story decisions and quarterly phases only with its quarterly list. Turn loop: answer each situation with ONE reply whose tool_calls array holds exactly two calls: [take_action(session_id, choice, notes), observe(session_id)]. Start the pattern on the opening Continue screen and keep it to the last month. Decide silently if you can; if you write anything, keep it to one short line and still send both calls in that same reply. The runner executes them in order and returns both results, so the observe already shows the next situation. Never send take_action alone and never observe in a reply of its own. Never end a reply with text only: until the run is over, every reply carries its tool calls, so put the decision in the take_action call, not in prose. In a quarterly phase, first quarter of the run: the Energy actions and observe, then the main action and observe, noting both menus' numbers; from the second quarter on, one reply with one take_action per Energy action, one for the main action, then observe. In every story, drop options that may bury a problem (private, anonymous, partial, later, hidden, skipping work to save time). In the two months before a review, keep Network and Output at their best this level and repair any loss at once; in the month before a review (Review in 1), and at your starting level also with Review in 2, never pick an option that may lower Skill, Network or Output when another avoids it; while the HR remark is friendly or quiet this comes before avoiding a mild risk. Stalled start (still at your starting level after two reviews): until the next review, no option that may add hidden risk in any month, Network and Output kept at their Best, and every quarter Defuse legacy risk first. Every note is one line: the status line and at most one short reason.
